verses.text: We write to you about the Word of life, who was there from the beginning. We have heard him, we have seen him with our own eyes, we looked at him, and our hands touched him.
This life was shown to us. We have seen it, and we tell you about it. We announce to you the life that lasts forever, which was with the Father and was shown to us.
We tell you what we have seen and heard, so that you can share in this life with us. And our sharing is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
We write these things to you so that our joy can be full.
This is the message we heard from him and now tell you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.
If we say that we share life with him, but we keep walking in darkness, we are lying and we are not living the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we share life with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.
If we say that we have no sin, we fool ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and fair. He will forgive our sins and make us clean from all the wrong we have done.
If we say that we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his word is not in us.
